files.name: candidate-relink.sh
files.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Runner-local relink diagnostics. Original executables are read-only mounts.
cd /build/objects
[[ $(pwd -P) == /build/objects ]]
for file in ffmpeg ffmpeg_g ffprobe ffprobe_g; do
 [[ -f "$file" && ! -L "$file" && $(stat -c %u "$file") == "$(id -u)" ]]
done
printf '%s  %s\n' \
 '031ffb3a5ccd03437daf983c121b9f01d3974ed8e295057faa912925f84db5f3' /original/ffmpeg \
 '36e837d351e47d525dd6438f0141c2c7dc4bc7d49e27e3836acff137a601b9b3' /original/ffprobe | sha256sum --check --strict
printf '%s  %s\n' \
 '9d6b43ce4d8de0c878bf16b54d8e7a10d9bd42b75178153e3af6a815bdc90f74' /experiment/notices/gcc/COPYING.RUNTIME \
 '8ceb4b9ee5adedde47b31e975c1d90c73ad27b6b165a1dcd80c7c545eb65b903' /experiment/notices/gcc/COPYING3 | sha256sum --check --strict
# No globs, recursive removal or source changes: only these four owned build outputs.
rm -- ffmpeg ffmpeg_g ffprobe ffprobe_g
export TMPDIR=/tmp
for tool in ffmpeg ffprobe; do
 (
  # Bash default units are1024bytes (POSIX mode512); either ceiling is <=16MiB.
  ulimit -f 16384
  timeout --kill-after=5s 60 make V=1 "LD=gcc -Wl,-t,-Map=/evidence/$tool.link-map.txt" "$tool" > "/evidence/$tool.link-trace.txt" 2>&1
 )
 for kind in link-map link-trace; do
  file="/evidence/$tool.$kind.txt"
  [[ -f "$file" && ! -L "$file" && $(stat -c %s "$file") -gt 0 && $(stat -c %s "$file") -le 16777216 ]]
 done
 # Any accidental source recompilation is outside this relink-only experiment.
 if grep -Eq '(^|[[:space:]])(-c|([^[:space:]]*/)?(nasm|yasm))([[:space:]]|$)' "/evidence/$tool.link-trace.txt"; then echo RELINK_RECOMPILED_SOURCE; exit 1; fi
 cmp --silent "/original/$tool" "$tool"
done
sha256sum /original/ffmpeg ffmpeg /original/ffprobe ffprobe > /evidence/relink-binaries.sha256
# Record observed considered absolute system/compiler linker inputs; never copy library/object bytes.
awk '$1=="LOAD" && $2 ~ /^\// && $2 !~ /^\/build\// {print $2}' /evidence/ffmpeg.link-map.txt /evidence/ffprobe.link-map.txt | sort -u > /evidence/runtime-input-paths.txt
[[ -s /evidence/runtime-input-paths.txt && $(wc -l < /evidence/runtime-input-paths.txt) -le 64 ]]
: > /evidence/runtime-inputs.tsv
while IFS= read -r file; do
 [[ "$file" == /usr/* || "$file" == /lib/* || "$file" == /lib64/* ]]
 resolved=$(readlink -f -- "$file")
 [[ "$resolved" == /usr/* || "$resolved" == /lib/* || "$resolved" == /lib64/* ]]
 [[ -f "$resolved" && ! -L "$resolved" ]]
 bytes=$(stat -c %s "$resolved")
 [[ "$bytes" -gt 0 && "$bytes" -le 20000000 ]]
 hash=$(sha256sum -- "$resolved"); hash=${hash%% *}
 printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$file" "$resolved" "$bytes" "$hash" >> /evidence/runtime-inputs.tsv
done < /evidence/runtime-input-paths.txt
{
 gcc -dumpfullversion
 gcc -print-libgcc-file-name
 gcc -print-file-name=crtbegin.o
 gcc -print-file-name=crtend.o
} > /evidence/gcc-runtime-locations.txt
dpkg-query -W '-f=${binary:Package}\t${Version}\t${source:Package}\t${source:Version}\n' libc6 libc6-dev > /evidence/system-package-versions.txt
cp /usr/share/doc/libc6/copyright /evidence/system-libc-copyright.txt
for file in runtime-inputs.tsv runtime-input-paths.txt gcc-runtime-locations.txt system-package-versions.txt system-libc-copyright.txt relink-binaries.sha256; do
 [[ -f "/evidence/$file" && ! -L "/evidence/$file" && $(stat -c %s "/evidence/$file") -gt 0 && $(stat -c %s "/evidence/$file") -le 131072 ]]
done
echo RELINK_IDENTICAL_WITH_OBSERVED_INPUT_PROVENANCE

files.name: candidate-recipe.sh
files.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /build
mkdir source
# The host independently validates every archive member before this bounded extraction.
tar --extract --gzip --file /source.tar.gz --directory source --strip-components=1 --no-same-owner --no-same-permissions
mkdir configure-tmp
export TMPDIR=/build/configure-tmp
mkdir objects
cd objects
args=(
 --disable-all --disable-autodetect --disable-iconv --disable-network --disable-doc --disable-debug
 --disable-shared --enable-static --disable-gpl --disable-nonfree --disable-version3
 --enable-x86asm --x86asmexe=/build/nasm-source/nasm --enable-ffmpeg --enable-ffprobe --enable-avcodec --enable-avformat
 --enable-avfilter --enable-swscale --enable-swresample --enable-pthreads
 "--enable-decoder=h264,aac,mjpeg" "--enable-parser=h264,aac,mjpeg"
 "--enable-demuxer=mov,image2,image_jpeg_pipe" "--enable-muxer=mp4,image2,null"
 "--enable-protocol=file,pipe" "--enable-bsf=filter_units,h264_metadata"
 "--enable-encoder=mjpeg,wrapped_avframe,pcm_s16le"
 "--enable-filter=scale,format,aformat,aresample"
)
printf '%s\n' "${args[@]}" > /evidence/configure-args.txt
gcc --version > /evidence/compiler.txt
ld --version > /evidence/binutils.txt
getconf GNU_LIBC_VERSION > /evidence/builder-libc.txt
cat /etc/os-release > /evidence/builder-os.txt
printf 'CONFIGURE\n' > /evidence/stage.txt
timeout 120 ../source/configure "${args[@]}" > /evidence/configure.log 2>&1
if grep -q 'WARNING:' /evidence/configure.log; then echo 'CONFIGURE_WARNING_REJECTED'; exit 1; fi
printf 'CONFIGURATION_GUARDS\n' > /evidence/stage.txt
cp config.h config_components.h /evidence/
cp ffbuild/config.mak /evidence/config.mak
# Reject the concrete external linkage previously observed in the broad binary.
if grep -Eq '^#define CONFIG_(GPL|NONFREE|VERSION3|NETWORK|CHROMAPRINT|LIBOPENH264|LIBX264|LIBX265|LIBFFTW3|ICONV|VAAPI|VDPAU|VULKAN) 1$' config.h config_components.h; then echo 'FORBIDDEN_CONFIG'; exit 1; fi
for component in H264_DECODER AAC_DECODER MJPEG_DECODER MJPEG_ENCODER WRAPPED_AVFRAME_ENCODER PCM_S16LE_ENCODER MOV_DEMUXER IMAGE_JPEG_PIPE_DEMUXER MP4_MUXER IMAGE2_MUXER NULL_MUXER FILTER_UNITS_BSF H264_METADATA_BSF; do
 grep -qx "#define CONFIG_${component} 1" config_components.h || { printf "Missing required component: %s\n" "$component" > /evidence/guard.log; exit 1; }
done
grep -qx '#define CONFIG_CBS_H264 1' config.h
printf 'COMPILE\n' > /evidence/stage.txt
timeout 900 make -j2 ffmpeg ffprobe > /evidence/build.log 2>&1
printf 'INSPECT\n' > /evidence/stage.txt
cp ffmpeg ffprobe /build/
for tool in ffmpeg ffprobe; do
 sha256sum "/build/$tool" > "/evidence/$tool.sha256"
 readelf --dynamic "/build/$tool" > "/evidence/$tool.dynamic.txt"
 readelf --version-info "/build/$tool" > "/evidence/$tool.versions.txt"
 "/build/$tool" -version > "/evidence/$tool.version.txt"
 "/build/$tool" -protocols > "/evidence/$tool.protocols.txt" 2>&1
done
/build/ffmpeg -hide_banner -decoders > /evidence/decoders.txt 2>&1
/build/ffmpeg -hide_banner -encoders > /evidence/encoders.txt 2>&1
/build/ffmpeg -hide_banner -filters > /evidence/filters.txt 2>&1
/build/ffmpeg -hide_banner -bsfs > /evidence/bsfs.txt 2>&1
cp ../source/LICENSE.md ../source/COPYING.* /evidence/
# No executable or archive is published. Full exact source stays in this owned CI build.
echo 'MINIMAL_BUILD=COMPLETED_EXPERIMENT_ONLY'

# License

Most files in FFmpeg are under the GNU Lesser General Public License version 2.1
or later (LGPL v2.1+). Read the file `COPYING.LGPLv2.1` for details. Some other
files have MIT/X11/BSD-style licenses. In combination the LGPL v2.1+ applies to
FFmpeg.

Some optional parts of FFmpeg are licensed under the GNU General Public License
version 2 or later (GPL v2+). See the file `COPYING.GPLv2` for details. None of
these parts are used by default, you have to explicitly pass `--enable-gpl` to
configure to activate them. In this case, FFmpeg's license changes to GPL v2+.

Specifically, the GPL parts of FFmpeg are:

- optional x86 optimization in the files
    - `libavcodec/x86/flac_dsp_gpl.asm`
    - `libavcodec/x86/idct_mmx.c`
    - `libavfilter/x86/vf_removegrain.asm`
- the following building and testing tools
    - `compat/solaris/make_sunver.pl`
    - `doc/t2h.pm`
    - `doc/texi2pod.pl`
    - `libswresample/tests/swresample.c`
    - `tests/checkasm/*`
    - `tests/tiny_ssim.c`
- the following filters in libavfilter:
    - `signature_lookup.c`
    - `vf_blackframe.c`
    - `vf_boxblur.c`
    - `vf_colormatrix.c`
    - `vf_cover_rect.c`
    - `vf_cropdetect.c`
    - `vf_delogo.c`
    - `vf_eq.c`
    - `vf_find_rect.c`
    - `vf_fspp.c`
    - `vf_histeq.c`
    - `vf_hqdn3d.c`
    - `vf_kerndeint.c`
    - `vf_lensfun.c` (GPL version 3 or later)
    - `vf_mcdeint.c`
    - `vf_mpdecimate.c`
    - `vf_nnedi.c`
    - `vf_owdenoise.c`
    - `vf_perspective.c`
    - `vf_phase.c`
    - `vf_pp7.c`
    - `vf_pullup.c`
    - `vf_repeatfields.c`
    - `vf_sab.c`
    - `vf_signature.c`
    - `vf_smartblur.c`
    - `vf_spp.c`
    - `vf_stereo3d.c`
    - `vf_super2xsai.c`
    - `vf_tinterlace.c`
    - `vf_uspp.c`
    - `vf_vaguedenoiser.c`
    - `vsrc_mptestsrc.c`

Should you, for whatever reason, prefer to use version 3 of the (L)GPL, then
the configure parameter `--enable-version3` will activate this licensing option
for you. Read the file `COPYING.LGPLv3` or, if you have enabled GPL parts,
`COPYING.GPLv3` to learn the exact legal terms that apply in this case.

There are a handful of files under other licensing terms, namely:

* The files `libavcodec/jfdctfst.c`, `libavcodec/jfdctint_template.c` and
  `libavcodec/jrevdct.c` are taken from libjpeg, see the top of the files for
  licensing details. Specifically note that you must credit the IJG in the
  documentation accompanying your program if you only distribute executables.
  You must also indicate any changes including additions and deletions to
  those three files in the documentation.
* `tests/reference.pnm` is under the expat license.


## External libraries

FFmpeg can be combined with a number of external libraries, which sometimes
affect the licensing of binaries resulting from the combination.

### Compatible libraries

The following libraries are under GPL version 2:
- avisynth
- frei0r
- libcdio
- libdavs2
- librubberband
- libvidstab
- libx264
- libx265
- libxavs
- libxavs2
- libxvid

When combining them with FFmpeg, FFmpeg needs to be licensed as GPL as well by
passing `--enable-gpl` to configure.

The following libraries are under LGPL version 3:
- gmp
- libaribb24
- liblensfun

When combining them with FFmpeg, use the configure option `--enable-version3` to
upgrade FFmpeg to the LGPL v3.

The VMAF, mbedTLS, RK MPI, OpenCORE and VisualOn libraries are under the Apache License
2.0. That license is incompatible with the LGPL v2.1 and the GPL v2, but not with
version 3 of those licenses. So to combine these libraries with FFmpeg, the
license version needs to be upgraded by passing `--enable-version3` to configure.

The smbclient library is under the GPL v3, to combine it with FFmpeg,
the options `--enable-gpl` and `--enable-version3` have to be passed to
configure to upgrade FFmpeg to the GPL v3.

### Incompatible libraries

There are certain libraries you can combine with FFmpeg whose licenses are not
compatible with the GPL and/or the LGPL. If you wish to enable these
libraries, even in circumstances that their license may be incompatible, pass
`--enable-nonfree` to configure. This will cause the resulting binary to be
unredistributable.

The Fraunhofer FDK AAC and OpenSSL libraries are under licenses which are
incompatible with the GPLv2 and v3. To the best of our knowledge, they are
compatible with the LGPL.

files.name: filters.txt
files.text:
Filters:
  T.. = Timeline support
  .S. = Slice threading
  A = Audio input/output
  V = Video input/output
  N = Dynamic number and/or type of input/output
  | = Source or sink filter
  ------
 .. aformat           A->A       Convert the input audio to one of the specified formats.
 .. anull             A->A       Pass the source unchanged to the output.
 .. aresample         A->A       Resample audio data.
 .. atrim             A->A       Pick one continuous section from the input, drop the rest.
 .. crop              V->V       Crop the input video.
 .. format            V->V       Convert the input video to one of the specified pixel formats.
 TS hflip             V->V       Horizontally flip the input video.
 .. null              V->V       Pass the source unchanged to the output.
 TS rotate            V->V       Rotate the input image.
 .. scale             V->V       Scale the input video size and/or convert the image format.
 .S transpose         V->V       Transpose input video.
 .. trim              V->V       Pick one continuous section from the input, drop the rest.
 T. vflip             V->V       Flip the input video vertically.
 .. abuffer           |->A       Buffer audio frames, and make them accessible to the filterchain.
 .. buffer            |->V       Buffer video frames, and make them accessible to the filterchain.
 .. abuffersink       A->|       Buffer audio frames, and make them available to the end of the filter graph.
 .. buffersink        V->|       Buffer video frames, and make them available to the end of the filter graph.
